title: Proving Convergence of Maclaurin Series for e^x
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Prove that the Maclaurin series for e^x converges to e^x for all real x.

steps.title: State Lagrange Remainder for e^x
steps.mathExpression: R_n(x) = \frac{f^{(n+1)}(c)}{(n+1)!} x^{n+1} = \frac{e^c}{(n+1)!} x^{n+1} \quad (c \text{ between } 0 \text{ and } x)
steps.explanation: All derivatives of e^x equal e^x.

steps.title: Bound e^c on Closed Interval
steps.explanation: e^c is bounded by constant M independent of n.

steps.title: Take Limit as n -> oo
steps.explanation: Factorials outgrow any fixed base power x^(n+1).
